title: Grateful Dead Live at Labor Temple on 1969-02-02
lineage: Dat (Tascam DA-20) -> Tascam SS-R05 -> Adobe Audition v3.0 ->Samplitude Professional v11.2.1 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording of a high‑energy February ’69 Minnesota show with an aggressive “Eleven” and a riotous Pigpen, good overall sound despite some cuts.
ai_review.review: The tape captures a fierce early‑1969 performance – Jerry’s incendiary take on “Eleven” and Pigpen’s lively banter stand out, and the soundboard source is noticeably clearer than earlier versions.  While the recording suffers from a few brutal cuts and the Minneapolis crowd was chilly, the musical intensity makes it a worthwhile listen.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong show quality with standout performances outweighs modest recording issues (cuts, but generally clear soundboard); weighted rating yields ~4.2 stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clearer than previous versions, but some brutal cuts are noted; overall listenable with decent mix.

show_quality.setlist_flow: High‑energy early set highlighted by aggressive “Eleven” and Pigpen’s banter; audience was cold and unreceptive, but the band kept momentum.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as channeling post‑Schoolgirl anger on an extremely aggressive “Eleven”.
